member.name: T:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo
member.summary: Content type information from HTTP headers.
member.remarks: This class encapsulates the results of a content type check performed via HTTP HEAD request. It is used to determine whether content should be navigated to in a browser context or downloaded directly via HTTP client.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo.IsNavigable
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the content is navigable in a browser context.
member.value: true if the content type indicates HTML or other browser-renderable content (e.g., text/html, application/xhtml+xml); otherwise, false for downloadable content such as PDFs, images, or other binary files.
member.remarks: When this value is true, the content can be loaded using browser automation tools like Playwright. When false, the content should be retrieved directly via HTTP client to preserve the binary data.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo.MediaType
member.summary: Gets or sets the MIME type of the content as reported by the Content-Type header.
member.value: The media type string (e.g., "text/html", "application/pdf", "image/jpeg"). May be null if the Content-Type header was not present or if the check failed.
member.remarks: This value is normalized to lowercase and excludes any charset or other parameters that may be present in the Content-Type header.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo.ContentLength
member.summary: Gets or sets the size of the content in bytes as reported by the Content-Length header.
member.value: The content length in bytes, or null if the Content-Length header was not present or if the check failed.
member.remarks: This can be useful for determining whether to download large files or for providing progress information during downloads. Note that some servers may not provide accurate Content-Length headers, especially for dynamically generated content.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo.CheckSucceeded
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the content type check completed successfully.
member.value: true if the HEAD request succeeded and headers were retrieved; otherwise, false if the request failed due to network issues, authentication problems, or server errors.
member.remarks: When this value is false, the property defaults to true as a safe fallback, allowing the crawler to attempt browser navigation. The crawler can then handle any download triggers that may occur during navigation.

member.name: M:CrawlSharp.Web.ContentTypeInfo.#ctor
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
member.remarks: Creates a new ContentTypeInfo with default values. By default, is set to false, is set to false, and both and are null.

member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class with specified values.

The MIME type of the content.

member.summary: Returns a string representation of the instance.
member.returns: A string containing the media type, navigability status, content length (if available), and check success status.

member.summary: Boolean indicating whether or not the contents of the webserver's robots.txt file should be ignored. This value should remain false unless you are crawling web servers that you own and operate or you have been provided explicit permission to do so.

member.summary: Boolean indicating whether or not the contents of the sitemap.xml should be included.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.FollowLinks
member.summary: Boolean specifying whether or not page links should be followed.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.FollowRedirects
member.summary: Boolean specifying whether or not redirects should be followed. Default is true. When true, the crawler follows redirects itself, one hop at a time: it stops after hops or when the chain returns to a URL it already requested, checks each target against robots.txt and (when is true) the crawl scope, pauses before each hop, and attaches credentials only to origins in the credential scope. When false, the first redirect response is returned as the result, with its Location header in , and the target is neither requested nor queued. See for why a chain stopped.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.MaxRedirects
member.summary: Maximum number of redirects to follow for a single resource. Default is 10. Minimum is 1 and maximum is 50; values outside that range throw. To follow no redirects, set to false. A longer chain ends with set to MaxRedirectsExceeded, and the hop past the limit is not requested.
member.exception: Thrown when the value is below 1 or above 50.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RestrictToChildUrls
member.summary: Boolean indicating if only links that are child URLs to the entry URL should be followed. Option is only valid when FollowLinks is set to true.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RestrictToSameSubdomain
member.summary: Boolean indicating if only links that are within the same subdomain to the entry URL should be followed. Option is only valid when FollowLinks is set to true.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RestrictToSameRootDomain
member.summary: Boolean indicating if only links that are within the same root domain to the entry URL should be followed. Option is only valid when FollowLinks is set to true.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.AllowedDomains
member.summary: List of allowed domains. If empty, all domains will be allowed. Otherwise, only the domains specified here will be allowed. Option is only valid when FollowLinks is set to true.

member.summary: One pause, in milliseconds, taken after a 429 (Too Many Requests) response just before that 429 is returned as the result. It applies only when is false or its are used up; it does not pace normal requests (see for that). Default is 5000. Minimum is 0; negative values throw.
member.exception: Thrown when the value is negative.

member.summary: Maximum number of retry attempts when receiving a 429 response. Default is 3. Minimum value is 1.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RetryMinBackoffMs
member.summary: Minimum backoff time in milliseconds when retrying after a 429 response. Default is 1000 (1 second). Minimum value is 100.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RetryMaxBackoffMs
member.summary: Maximum backoff time in milliseconds when retrying after a 429 response. Default is 30000 (30 seconds). Minimum value is 1000.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RetryBackoffJitter
member.summary: Boolean indicating whether or not to add random jitter to the backoff delay when retrying after a 429 response. Default is true.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.RequestDelayMs
member.summary: Pause, in milliseconds, before every request: pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and each redirect hop. The pause is taken per parallel task, so with set to 8, up to eight requests can start per interval. A Crawl-delay in robots.txt replaces this value entirely, whether higher or lower; exposes the value in effect. Default is 2500. Minimum is 0; negative values are set to 0.

member.name: P:CrawlSharp.Web.CrawlSettings.AutoExpandCollapsibles
member.summary: Boolean indicating whether or not common collapsible content should be expanded before capturing rendered HTML in headless browser mode. Ignored when is false. Default is false.

member.summary: Optional delay in milliseconds after page navigation completes and before any headless auto-expansion logic runs. Ignored when headless auto-expansion is disabled. Default is 0.

member.name: M:CrawlSharp.Web.WebCrawler.RegisterVisited(System.Uri,System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable{System.Uri},System.Uri,CrawlSharp.Web.WebResource)
member.summary: Record the requested URL, every URL requested along its chain and the final URL as visited, all pointing at one resource, so a later link to any of them does not replay the chain. When the final URL was already retrieved by another path, the existing resource wins and is returned instead, which keeps a page reached twice from being yielded twice.

member.name: M:CrawlSharp.Web.WebCrawler.RouteWithCredentials(Microsoft.Playwright.IRoute,System.Action)
member.summary: Attach credentials to browser requests whose origin is in the credential scope. The request is fetched without following redirects and its response handed to the browser. route.ContinueAsync with headers is not used, because Playwright carries those headers onto every redirect the request starts, including cross-origin ones. Playwright does not route the requests a redirect starts, so the browser would follow a redirect without credentials. For a subresource that is the safe direction and is accepted. A redirected navigation is aborted instead, and tells the caller to resolve the chain itself and navigate to where it ends.
